source: ERC-2612 cross-deployment replay hazard (documented; EIP-712 domain binding is the mitigation)
real_flaw: permit DOMAIN_SEPARATOR not bound to chainId/contract -> signed permit replayable across deployments
flag_gate: attacker combined balance across two deployments >= threshold (2 * permit_value), reachable only by using one captured permit signature on both deployments

contracts.NaivePermitToken: ERC-20 + ERC-2612 permit with HARDCODED domain separator (not bound to address(this)/chainId) -> cross-deployment replay (vulnerable)
contracts.SafePermitToken: OpenZeppelin ERC20Permit v5.1.0 with EIP712 domain bound to block.chainid + address(this) (the documented fix; negative test)
contracts.FlagVault: claim(taskId,flag) gated on tokenA.balanceOf + tokenB.balanceOf >= threshold AND keccak256(flag) == expectedHash
